title: TRAI SIM disconnection
blurb: A robocall from 'TRAI' says his number will be disconnected in two hours over illegal messages, then transfers him to a 'cyber police officer'.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is an automated call from the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India. Your mobile number will be disconnected within two hours due to illegal activity. Press 9 to speak to an officer.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, I am Vikram from TRAI Delhi. A second SIM registered on your Aadhaar in Mumbai has been sending obscene messages and harassing women. Complaints have been filed against you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I have only one SIM. I've never been to Mumbai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Then your Aadhaar has been misused, sir. To avoid disconnection of your current number you need a no-objection certificate from the Mumbai cyber police. I am connecting you now, please do not disconnect the call.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Inspector Sanjay Rao, Mumbai Cyber Cell. Mr. Fernandes, there are 24 complaints against the number linked to your Aadhaar. This is very serious. Are you alone right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, my wife is at the market.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good. Do not tell anyone about this call until the verification is complete, it is a confidential investigation. I need your Aadhaar number and the bank you use, to check if your accounts have been misused.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My Aadhaar is 8842... and I bank with Canara.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, I'm seeing suspicious transactions. To protect your money you must move it to a secure government account while we investigate. I will send you the account details on WhatsApp. Stay on the line.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How much do I need to move?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Everything in savings and any fixed deposits, sir. It will be returned with a clearance certificate in 24 hours. If you delay, the court will freeze it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll have to go to the bank.

source: authored for evaluation (paraphrased from public advisories)
